name: first merge of a new app whose oversize lockfile hides a git source with an install script
why: The fold that lets an oversize lockfile through must keep what policy 06 rejects on: an entry the chain never asked for, from a git host rather than the registry, with an install script. Code keeps those lines; the reviewer must not approve it.
